environment: isolated real PostgreSQL 18, loopback, 20 simultaneous connections; NOT a production capacity benchmark
tests: new courses have genuine lesson counts and cannot publish an empty curriculum
member catalog uses keyset pages beyond 1000 rows without duplicates, including equal timestamps
Arabic search is generic; large limits are clamped and draft flags cannot bypass RLS
indexed catalog handles 1000 requests through 20 simultaneous real connections
concurrent enrollment retries create one enrollment/reward per member and accurate totals
concurrent lesson/quiz retries issue exactly one linked certificate and only persisted rewards

course request throttling is shared across connections, returns 429, and recovers next window
curriculum edits wait for a real completion transaction, with no mixed curriculum certificate
